review_type: Codex factual consistency check; not substitute for required Claude plan review
implementation_authorization: No implementation or solve performed; required independent plan review remains pending

findings.claim: Historical row preservation needs a normalization step before existing build_package API.
findings.evidence: build_package hashes each supplied case including any existing row_hash. Empirical existing-row digest differs when old row_hash is included; removing it reproduces original row_hash exactly.
findings.required_clarification: Specify removal of derived case/package hash fields before rebuilding, then assert all eight resulting historical case records and row hashes equal r1.

findings.claim: Unattempted source kind and evidence references should be prescribed alongside the proposed execution/calculation status mapping.
findings.evidence: validate_case requires source_kind and nonempty evidence; every response needs an evidence ID; build_package resolves every supplied reference even when required=false.
findings.required_clarification: Use source_kind=unverified for pending native observations, evidence tied to retained deck/case manifest and criteria, no invented or unreachable native-output references. Retain calculated-null/not_evaluated distinction and explicit unattempted reason. Freeze unique response names for all station/quantity pairs and RFY.

findings.claim: Finding applicability language must retain existing fail-closed lookup semantics.
findings.evidence: analysis_lookup._check_provenance unions all package findings with response findings and only accepts authority disposition=resolved plus justification and live evidence. It does not recognize not_applicable as an alternative gate state.
findings.required_clarification: Document justified applicability disposition through the existing authority record; preserve historical13 findings and do not omit them or introduce an unsupported bypass status.

supported_conclusions: Proposed unknown/not_evaluated/null literals are supported by current validators.
Native completion, numerical outcome and qualified lookup remain explicitly separate in plan.
Existing dataset owner/id and immutable publication API are reused.
No additional database or schema replacement is needed for initial diagnostic revision.
